describe.chat: Create a NEW deck from complete Lattice Markdown (front matter, then slides separated by ---), for when the author asks for a new deck rather than a change to this one. It does not happen yet: the author sees the title and outline and confirms. Call it once per turn, after drafting the whole deck; then tell the author it is ready for them to confirm. The open deck is not changed.
